subject: Trial top-up: accounting treatment & ledger method
body:
From: Sara Quinn <sara@origenhealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@origenhealth.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Trial top-up request / invoice 0427

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the productive demo last week — the team at Origen is seeing good early results and we'd like to request a $12,000 trial top-up for the production preview next month. Our procurement asked me to check whether Redwood will issue a credit memo applied to invoice 0427 or if you can apply this as an invoice offset on the next billing cycle.

Invoice details: ORG-0427 (issued 2027-04-27), net $12,000.
Use case: extend trial quota and grant extra token credits for a 45-day ramp.

We need the accounting treatment note for our auditors (how it will appear on our AP ledger). Can you confirm what you need from our side to make this happen?

Best,
Sara Quinn
Director of Ops, Origen Health

Hi Sara — appreciate the note and congrats to your team on the early traction. I'm looping in Finance & Accounting so we can align on the clearest path for your auditors. 

Marissa/Marcus/Karthik — Origen is requesting a $12k trial top-up. They asked whether we should:
- issue a credit memo referencing invoice ORG-0427, or
- post a contra invoice / offset on their next invoice (i.e., net against future charges), or
- post a manual journal entry as a promotional allowance (affects revenue recognition differently).

They also need a short description we can provide to their AP team. I've attached the invoice (invoice_ORG-0427.pdf) and a screenshot of the request.

Can you advise preferred treatment and any GL mapping we should use? Also confirm what the AP/Customer will see in their ledger.

Thanks,
Neha
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---

On Sat, May 22, 2027 at 13:02 Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 13:02:10 -0700
Subject: RE: Trial top-up request / invoice 0427

Thanks for the context. From an accounting/control perspective our recommended default for a promotional/stipend top-up like this is to issue a credit memo against ORG-0427 and then close it as a contra to revenue when the customer applies it. That keeps the customer AP clean (they’ll see a credit tied to the invoice) and gives us an audit trail. 

GL guidance:
- Credit Memo revenue contra: use GL 4105-PromoAllowances
- When reversing: JE to move from 4105 to appropriate revenue bucket when recognized

If the customer prefers an offset on the next invoice, we can do a netting entry but that requires a separate memo in the invoice narrative and will show as a negative line on the next AR invoice rather than a standalone credit memo. For audit purposes the standalone credit memo is easier.

I can draft the credit memo and assign it to Marcus to post — Marcus, can you confirm you have the rights to create CM for ORG and tag as 4105? Also confirm whether we should set an expiry date on the credit memo (30/45 days).

Marissa
Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations

I can create the credit memo. Two quick items before I post:
1) Deal/contract reference — please confirm Deal ID (I see DEAL-4821 but want to ensure the HubSpot link is correct).
2) Expiry — recommend 45 days given this is a short ramp and they explicitly asked for a 45-day preview.

If we proceed with CM: I'll create CM-ORG-20270522-01 for $12,000 and tag GL 4105-PromoAllowances. This will be applied to invoice ORG-0427 in our AR system; on the customer side it will appear as a credit memo linked to that invoice.

If Karthik prefers journal entry approach, call it out and I will not create the CM yet.

Marcus
Senior Accountant, Redwood Inference

On Sat, May 22, 2027 at 15:20 Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:

Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 15:20:45 -0700
Subject: RE: Trial top-up request / invoice 0427

Quick thought: from a revenue reporting view, booking as a promotional allowance (credit memo) is fine. However, if product usage shows steady conversion we should avoid creating a permanent contra on the invoice; alternatively we could post a manual JE (memo: Top-up grant ORG/DEAL-4821) and tag it as 'Other promotional allowance' so it doesn't reduce recognized revenue until conversion. Either approach is acceptable; my preference is to issue the CM now (so Origen's AP is clean) and then handle recognition via JE adjustments at period close if needed.

Neha — please instruct Marcus to create the CM with 45-day expiry and include Deal ID in the memo. Also please send Origen a short accounting description that they can attach to their AP records (I suggest: "Redwood promotional credit memo; $12,000 applied to invoice ORG-0427; exp 2027-07-06").

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Sales Operations
